product_metadata.title: HIC Essentials Kiwi Green Silicone 11 Inch Spoon Spatula
features: Flexes and bends to shape of bowl
Great for mixing batters and ingredients
Head is slightly curved like a spoon for scooping
Heat resistant up to 600 degrees F
description: Whip up your favorite dessert with the help of this HIC Essentials spoon shaped spatula. It is made of kiwi green colored silicone, and easily curves and bends to the shape of your bowl for maximum effect. It is perfect for mixing batters and ingredients, and uses a handy hanging eyelet for storage purposes. The head is slightly curved, like a spoon, which is helpful when scooping out those last ingredients. As part of the Essentials line by Harold Import Company, a portion of each sale goes towards the C-CAP program, a culinary scholarship organization for high school students.
